land_tenure.evidence: Brownfield expansion at Bastrop Energy Center (RN101056851, 125 Old Bastrop Rd Cedar Creek) where Bastrop Energy Partners LP is the existing owner/operator; MPH is the new operator layer, so land tenure is likely inherited from the existing plant footprint rather than newly acquired. Bastrop CAD (esearch.bastropcad.org) portal is JS-rendered off internal XHR and did not yield scrapable parcel rows for MPH Bastrop / Bastrop Energy Partners / 125 Old Bastrop this pass — see log D6.

evidence: Sentinel-2 xwide chip 2024-01-15 ±30d (imagery/s2_2024-01.png) shows the existing Bastrop Energy Center industrial buildings mid-frame; the pasture/farmland immediately north/east of the existing plant is entirely undisturbed.

Sentinel-2 xwide chip 2026-07-01 ±15d (imagery/s2_2026-07.png) and its ~3 km center crop (imagery/s2_2026-07_center_crop.png) show the same existing plant plus a very large bright tan rectangular graded pad (~800 m across) immediately north/east of the existing complex.

No turbine hall, cooling structures, transformer/switchyard build-out, or crane pad visible on the new graded area at 10 m/px in 2026-07 — consistent with early bulk earthwork, not late-stage construction.

Cannot bracket first-activity month tighter than 2024-01 → 2026-07 this pass: CDSE OAuth password grant locked out during deep scan (HTTP 401/403) and a full-range monthly timelapse retry produced no frames within the 5-min budget.

reasoning_evidence: The queue-reported COD 2027-12-07 has already slipped twice pre-construction: 2026-05-31 → 2027-03-31 (2025-11) → 2027-12-07 (2026-01), 18+ months of drift across three snapshots (timeline.md). The IA PDF was not obtained this pass so the contractual Scheduled COD cannot be independently confirmed.

MPH's own TEF filing on 2025-10-08 (sources/2025-10-08_puct_56896-83_mph-bastrop-peakers-extension-request.pdf) requested extension of the TEF initial disbursement deadline to 2026-12-31, citing 'EPC availability, supply chain issues, and electrical interconnect timing'. That is the developer publicly signaling first draw not expected before end-2026 — inconsistent with a Dec-2027 COD on a 1104 MW gas plant.

Observed imagery in 2026-07 is early-grading only — no turbine hall, no cooling, no transformer yard, no laydown/crane arrangement. Gas peaker fleets at 1 GW scale typically need 24-36 months from pad-ready to COD (F/H-class frame lead times currently 24-36 months; erection, mechanical completion, hot commissioning, and Trial Operation add several more).

Positive reality signals that keep the project 'real_early' rather than 'paper': ERCOT IA signed 2025-12-19 per queue; TCEQ NSR Air Permit 178585 ACTIVE with MPH Bastrop Peakers as operator (sources/2026-07-18_tceq_air-permit-178585-mph-facility.html) — mandatory-permit gap closed; parent Hull Street Energy is a real infrastructure investor filing with PUCT under actual name; existing brownfield has water/gas/electrical infrastructure and an ongoing operator, so no greenfield permitting/land-assembly barriers.

Independent estimate: pad-ready by end-2026 (TEF disbursement schedule), turbine delivery/erection through 2028, commissioning 2028-Q4, COD 2029-Q1. Meaningful downside risk (turbine lead time, gas/water tie-in coordination) into 2029-Q3+. Drift risk HIGH: 15+ months slip from the reported claim.
